items.problem: WMC0909 'Cannot resolve DataType local:Scenario' + WMC1111 'DataTemplates containing x:Bind need a DataType' after the agent authored an x:Bind ItemTemplate with x:DataType="local:Scenario".
items.evidence: session-log.txt lines 2424-2425 (errors) and turn 24 (line 2480-2483) where the agent reverted the template to a plain {Binding Title} in the same turn.
items.covered_clearly_at: MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md '### x:Bind and compiled bindings' (line 771) and '### XAML namespace mapping (recap)' (line 779): x:Bind is supported with the same syntax and stale/incorrect xmlns prefixes cause type-resolution errors.
items.why_no_skill_change: The agent introduced this itself by converting a working {Binding} into an x:Bind with a DataType the local: xmlns didn't expose, then fixed it in the same turn. The skill already documents x:Bind and xmlns resolution; a capable model on re-run would either keep the original {Binding} or supply a valid x:DataType. No general gap.
